binary_proof_signal.note: This is what T49 called '1 bit' but actual entropy depends on distribution

full_band_membership.note: Full information revealed by band-based verification

corrections_to_prior_analyses.t29_t36: Assumed 4 bands, excluded <400 partition. Understated leakage by 0.42 bits (26.5%).
corrections_to_prior_analyses.t49: Reported '1 bit' but conflated binary signal with full partition. Binary signal is ~0.78 bits; full partition is ~1.99 bits.

chapter_5_update: With 4 threshold bands {400, 550, 700, 850}, borrowers are partitioned into 5 groups (including <400). Full band membership reveals H = 1.99 bits of information. The proof/no-proof binary signal alone reveals H = 0.78 bits, dominated by the 22.8% of borrowers who cannot generate any proof.
